assumptions: collision key = source path; resolution = fail loudly naming both sources; no filename renames; decided by human at fleet CONFIRM
Identical sources declared under two shapes dedupe silently: no result row and no warning, because a legal declaration must not raise a finding on every scheduled freshness check.
The abort is a pre-pass that runs before any file is written, so --apply never leaves a partially installed .github/workflows/ and dry run and apply reach the same verdict.
The abort is a plain Error rather than a new exported error class: an export consumed only inside its own module trips the dead-export ratchet and no caller needs to discriminate it.
checkFreshness calls installWorkflows in dry-run mode, so a colliding overlay now aborts the freshness check too. That is the intended fail-loudly behaviour for a malformed overlay.
PR #1000 is already MERGED (not parked as the issue text says); this change amends the basename-keyed map it landed rather than replacing an open PR.
